note: Fourth run of the same messages, after two prompt changes made on 21 Nov: the assistant now explains why it stays quiet when someone shares bad news, and a problem happening now is no longer saved as a reminder. Earlier runs scored 60 of 60. One earlier rule (errands for family) was shaped by the BP

outcomes.text: This is Inspector Sharma from CBI Mumbai. A parcel in your name contains illegal drugs. You are under digital arrest. Do not disconnect or tell anyone. Transfer Rs 50,000 to the RBI safe account for verification.
outcomes.detail: fake police or arrest threat: The caller threatens arrest, demands secrecy, and asks you to transfer money to a supposed safe account.

outcomes.text: Dear customer aapka SBI account KYC expire ho gaya hai. Aaj raat tak account block ho jayega. Abhi is link par click karke update karein: http://sbi-kyc-update.in
outcomes.detail: fake account or KYC block: The message threatens to block your SBI account and asks you to click a link to update your details.

outcomes.text: Nanna, nenu ra. Idi naa kotha number. Urgent ga 20,000 kavali, hospital lo unna. Ee number ki GPay cheyyi, evvariki cheppaku.
outcomes.detail: pretending to be a relative: The sender claims to be a relative on a new number, urgently asks for ₹20,000 and says not to tell anyone.

outcomes.text: Congratulations! You have been selected for a work-from-home job. Earn Rs 5,000 daily by liking videos. Pay Rs 999 registration fee to start.
outcomes.detail: fake job or paid task: The message promises easy money for liking videos but asks you to pay a registration fee first.

outcomes.text: Your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM as your bill is not updated. Call officer 98765xxxxx immediately and share the OTP.

outcomes.text: FedEx: Your parcel is held at customs. Pay Rs 2,350 clearance fee within 2 hours or it will be returned. Pay here: http://fedex-clearance.co

outcomes.text: Sir main TRAI se bol raha hoon. Aapka number 2 ghante mein band ho jayega kyunki ispe illegal activity hui hai. Police verification ke liye abhi video call par aaiye aur kisi ko mat bataiye.
